title: BTCUSDT USD-M open-interest-conditioned funding-sign persistence

sources.partition_boundary_completeness: metrics first=start+5m and last=end-5m; mark and contract bars first=start and last=end-5m; funding first within 1000ms of start and final gap no larger than the final advertised interval plus 1000ms

datasets.timestamp_format: UTC text YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS interpreted as +00:00

hypothesis.oi_observation_rule: for event t, current OI is the latest row with create_time <= t-5m and age from that cutoff <=10m; baseline OI is the latest row with create_time <= t-window-5m and age from that cutoff <=10m; timestamps must be 5m-aligned, no row after either cutoff is admissible, and forward-fill beyond 10m is forbidden
hypothesis.entry_rule: close of first complete contract 5m bar after t
hypothesis.direction_rule: positive funding at t => short; negative funding at t => long
hypothesis.holding_rule: hold through exactly the next actual funding settlement t+1
hypothesis.exit_rule: close of first complete contract 5m bar after t+1
hypothesis.funding_rule: apply archived funding rate at t+1 to position quantity times latest complete mark-price bar at-or-before t+1
hypothesis.timestamp_rule: retain exact archived funding milliseconds; cadence is valid when elapsed time is within 1000ms of either adjacent row's advertised interval, which admits interval transitions without rounding or normalizing timestamps

trial_family.champion_rule: highest development stress mean net PnL among trials passing every development gate; stable trial id breaks ties

capacity_proxy.lookback: exactly 288 gap-free complete contract 5m bars with close_time in [t-24h,t)
capacity_proxy.clock: funding event t; no bar with close_time >= t and no OI row after the signal OI cutoff is admissible
capacity_proxy.formula: min(0.000001 * sum(prior 288 quote_asset_volume), 0.000001 * current lagged sum_open_interest_value)
capacity_proxy.label: PUBLIC_COARSE_PROXY_NOT_EXECUTABLE_DEPTH

tests: one-sided centered circular-block bootstrap per trial
Holm step-down across all eight frozen trials
White max-mean centered circular-block reality check
CSCV/PBO diagnostic over eight chronological 28-day development blocks and all 70 four-block train/four-block test splits
chronological holdout confirmation only after champion seal

cscv_pbo.split_rule: all combinations choosing 4 of the 8 blocks as training; the other 4 are test
cscv_pbo.selection: highest training stress mean; stable trial id breaks ties
cscv_pbo.loss_event: selected trial test stress mean ranks in the bottom half of the eight trials; stable trial id breaks ties

custody.data_root_marker: S1O_DATA_ROOT.json binds schema, protocol SHA-256, public base URL, and canonical absolute root
custody.custody_file_identity: every planned ZIP and checksum must be a regular non-symlink single-link file with a unique device/inode identity

known_limitations: official public-data README does not document metrics semantic derivation, publication latency, or correction policy
archive fundingRate rows do not expose the current REST rateType field
five-minute bars are price, mark, slippage, and capacity proxies rather than executable quotes or fills
account-effective fees, executable depth, fill probability, latency, impact, historical filters, and liquidation mechanics are UNKNOWN
